entries.title: Hosea 6:1
entries.author: R. A. Torrey (editor)
entries.content:
1 Exhortations to repent and hope in God. 4 A lamentation over those who had sinned after conviction. 5 Reproofs of obstinate sinners, and threatenings against them.

and let. 5:15; 14:1; Isa 2:3; 55:7; Jer 3:22; 50:4; La 3:40,41; Zep 2:1 he hath torn. 5:12-14; 13:7-9; De 32:39; 1Sa 2:6; Job 5:18; 34:29; Ps 30:7 Isa 30:22; Jer 30:12; 33:5; La 3:32,33
